reference_sql:
WITH monthly AS (
  -- one row per month with spend, 2024 and 2025
  SELECT CAST(date_trunc('month', spend_date) AS DATE) AS month, SUM(spend) AS spend_eur
  FROM ad_spend_daily
  WHERE spend_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31'
  GROUP BY CAST(date_trunc('month', spend_date) AS DATE)
)
SELECT m.month, m.spend_eur, p.spend_eur AS spend_prev_year_eur,
  ROUND(100.0 * (m.spend_eur - p.spend_eur) / p.spend_eur, 1) AS growth_pct
FROM monthly m
LEFT JOIN monthly p ON p.month = m.month - INTERVAL 1 YEAR
WHERE m.month >= DATE '2025-01-01'

WITH monthly AS (
  -- one row per month with spend, 2024 and 2025
  SELECT CAST(date_trunc('month', spend_date) AS DATE) AS month, SUM(spend) AS spend_eur
  FROM ad_spend_daily
  WHERE spend_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31'
  GROUP BY CAST(date_trunc('month', spend_date) AS DATE)
), compared AS (
  -- one row per month with spend, with the same month a year before
  SELECT m.month, m.spend_eur, p.spend_eur AS spend_prev_year_eur
  FROM monthly m
  LEFT JOIN monthly p ON year(p.month) = year(m.month) - 1 AND month(p.month) = month(m.month)
)
SELECT month, spend_eur, spend_prev_year_eur,
  ROUND(100.0 * (spend_eur - spend_prev_year_eur) / spend_prev_year_eur, 1) AS growth_pct
FROM compared
WHERE month >= DATE '2025-01-01'

solver.query:
WITH m AS (
  SELECT CAST(date_trunc('month', spend_date) AS DATE) AS month, SUM(spend) AS spend_eur
  FROM ad_spend_daily
  WHERE spend_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31'
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT cur.month, cur.spend_eur, prev.spend_eur AS spend_prev_year_eur,
  ROUND(100.0 * (cur.spend_eur - prev.spend_eur) / prev.spend_eur, 1) AS growth_pct
FROM m cur
LEFT JOIN m prev ON prev.month = CAST(cur.month - INTERVAL 1 YEAR AS DATE)
WHERE cur.month >= DATE '2025-01-01'
